This data was collected in a survey. Respondents were asked to specify "all that apply" and given a list of whether they have a pet, like to travel, like movies, or like books.

```{python}

        "has_pet": [True, False, True, False, True],
        "likes_travel": [False, False, False, False, True],
        "likes_movies": [True, False, True, False, True],
        "likes_books": [False, False, True, True, True],
        "likes_books": [False, False, True, True, True],
    }
)

```
